details.metric_about: PTY input injection to corresponding changed terminal bytes

sampling.boundary: wall time from immediately before one key's bytes are written until the first answering bytes arrive from the surface
sampling.cache_method: one fresh surface session per run on a 120-column, 40-row xterm-256color pseudo-terminal, driven with --reduced-updates so bytes mean a frame change
sampling.order_rule: one recorded-seed coin flip per block decides baseline/candidate order

statistics.method: nearest-rank; all samples retained including slow ones
